body.x: The joint participation of Korean small- and medium-sized companies from the IT and mobile fields received much attention from foreign buyers and visitors at the world’s best IT technology exhibition ‘CES(Consumer Technology Show) 2016’ which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas Convention Center(LVCC).

The Mobile Technology Convergence Center (MTCC, Center Director Choi Seok-kwon) of Daegu TP (Director Kwon Eob) prepared the joint pavilion at “CES 2016” and supported the participating companies’ meetings with buyers in hopes of advancing into foreign markets.

Located in Westgate Hotel, MTCC’s joint pavilion had many visitors, even on the 6th, the first day of the event. It proved the Korean companies' high reputation in the global market. In particular, the participating startups' ITC-based new technologies related to drones and robots received much attention.

MTCC Center Director Choi Seok-kwon said: “We recruited 27 small and middle-sized companies, venture businesses, and startups. At the joint pavilion, we are supporting those companies' products and various marketing projects for advancing into foreign markets.”
“We could provide an opportunity for companies related to drones, IoT, 3D, and wearable devices to become global brands.”

MTCC is supporting selected companies’ participation in domestic and international exhibitions, promoting mobile business. It is mainly focused on the competitiveness reinforcement business of new mobile convergence in the global market.

Held annually in January and owned and produced by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA), CES 2016 is the world's largest exhibition to see the latest global trends in electronics and IT industry in one spot.

AVING News has been sending its reporters to CES for 11 years to introduce the new technologies and products. After the local coverage and research, AVING News will hold 'CES 2016 Review Conference' in AVING Studio, Korea on January 28th.
